name: Somers Day Camp
description_short: Town day camp at Reis Park for Somers residents entering kindergarten to 8th grade, six weeks, drop off 8:30 to 9 and pick up 2:30 to 3, with arts and crafts, sports, games, performers and special events. Somers Middle School is the rain site, and an after camp program runs until 6.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camps/Clinics page: Somers Day Camp for Somers residents entering kindergarten through 8th grade at Reis Park, Monday to Friday, drop off 8:30 to 9 and pick up 2:30 to 3, six weeks June to August; arts and crafts, sports, games, performers and special events; 2026 registration opened April 9. No fee posted. Ages derived from grades. Outdoor inferred from a park camp with a rain site.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Parent Handbook: camp at Reis Park Monday June 29 to Friday August 7, 8:30 to 2:30, no camp July 3; Somers Middle School in bad weather; After Camp 3 to 6 pm, $275 for the six weeks; trips; nut free. ZIP 10589 is from the department's mailing address (P.O. Box 46, Somers, NY 10589); no street number is given for Reis Park.

No camp fee is posted for 2026 (only the $275 after camp fee). List it without a price?
